policy_metadata.policy_title: Initial Preventive Physical Examination and Annual Wellness Visit

sections.heading: Overview
content: According to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, an initial preventive physical examination (IPPE), also known as the "Welcome to Medicare" preventive visit, is a one-time introductory visit provided during the first 12 months a Medicare beneficiary has Part B benefits. The visit may include, but is not limited to, the following: • A review of a beneficiary's medical and health-related social history. • Education and counseling about preventive services, including certain screenings, shots and referrals for other care, if needed. • Other services, such as a written plan letting the beneficiary know what preventive services the beneficiary needs. If a beneficiary has had Part B benefits for longer than 12 months, the beneficiary can receive an annual wellness visit (AWV) to develop or update a personalized prevention plan to prevent disease and disability based on the beneficiary’s current health and risk factors. The following policy outlines Humana’s reimbursement for claims for an IPPE and AWV.

sections.heading: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
content: In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements. Humana Medicare Advantage plans reimburse a charge for: • An IPPE service, HCPCS code G0402 , once per lifetime and only if provided within the first 12 months after the effective date of the member’s first Medicare Part B coverage period. • An initial AWV service, HCPCS code G0438 , once per lifetime beginning in the calendar year following the IPPE. However, the initial AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier IPPE. • A subsequent AWV service, HCPCS code G0439 , once per calendar year beginning in the calendar year following an allowed charge for HCPCS code G0438 . However, a subsequent AWV is not dependent on reimbursement of an earlier AWV or IPPE. Humana limits reimbursement of HCPCS codes G0402, G0438 and G0439 to only one of these services per calendar year.

sections.heading: Additional Resources on this Topic
content: Humana’s Making it Easier web-based training series includes a video on the proper reporting and reimbursement of Medicare Advantage Preventive Services , Medicare Advantage Preventive Services – FQHC and Medicare Advantage Preventive Services – RHC that may supplement your understanding of this policy.

sections.heading: Definitions of Italicized Terms
content: • HCPCS code G0402: Initial preventive physical examination; face-to-face visit, services limited to new beneficiary during the first 12 months of Medicare enrollment. • HCPCS code G0438: Annual wellness visit; includes a personalized prevention plan of service (PPS), initial visit. • HCPCS code G0439: Annual wellness visit; includes a personalized prevention plan of service (PPS), subsequent visit.
